title: Release muxxy v0.2.0 on GitHub
description: Bump version, tag, push, and publish a GitHub release with the release binary attached.
close_reason: Released v0.2.0: tagged, pushed, and published to GitHub Releases with the binary.

title: Add tmux-backed integration tests
description: tests/integration.rs spins up an isolated tmux server per test on a dedicated socket running python3 -i, exercising is-repl-ready, execute-command (incl. slow commands), get-last-command, busy detection, and the split-pane + send-keys setup flow end to end. Skips gracefully without tmux.
close_reason: Implemented and verified live against Python and SBCL REPLs (incl. the debugger multi-prompt case).

title: Fix execute-command race with change detection
description: After send-keys the first capture could still show the old idle prompt, returning before the command ran. wait_for_idle now has two phases: wait for the pane to change from the pre-send state (command echo), then wait for a bare prompt. Fast commands cannot hang.
close_reason: Implemented and verified live against Python and SBCL REPLs (incl. the debugger multi-prompt case).

title: Emit YAML output with literal block scalars
description: Replace JSON output with a hand-rolled YAML emitter: multiline REPL output as |- / | block scalars (nearly identical to the original), strings that would parse as numbers/bools/null/timestamps quoted for round-trip fidelity, verified with serde_yaml round-trip tests.
close_reason: Implemented and verified live against Python and SBCL REPLs (incl. the debugger multi-prompt case).

title: Support multiple prompt patterns and --kind presets
description: Replace the single --prompt with a set of prompt regexes (repeatable --prompt, or --kind built-in presets merged with TMUX_REPL_KINDS env). Any prompt in the set is a valid block boundary and readiness check. Kinds carry a label so is-repl-ready reports which kind matched. SBCL's debugger prompts (0], 1], ldb>) are valid ready prompts.
close_reason: Implemented and verified live against Python and SBCL REPLs (incl. the debugger multi-prompt case).

title: Add split-pane and send-keys pane setup tooling
description: split-pane splits the target pane, optionally feeds setup commands with sleeps (repeatable --command/--sleep zipped), and prints the new pane id via split-window -P -F '#{pane_id}'. send-keys sends one or more commands with --sleep between. Both work without --prompt.
close_reason: Implemented and verified live against Python and SBCL REPLs (incl. the debugger multi-prompt case).

title: Push beads and initial code to the muxxy remote
description: Configure sync.remote for git+ssh://git@github.com/djha-skin/muxxy.git, push beads via bd dolt push, and push the initial commit (code, README, AGENTS.md) to origin.
close_reason: Code and beads pushed to origin (refs/dolt/data + main).

title: Verify muxxy end-to-end against a live tmux REPL
description: Spin up an isolated tmux server (separate socket) running python3 -i; confirm is-repl-ready, execute-command (incl. waiting for a 1s multi-line job and capturing all output lines), get-last-command, busy-state detection, timeout, bad-regex exit code, and missing-socket error handling.
close_reason: Completed and verified against a live tmux Python REPL.

title: Implement execute-command wait loop with busy detection
description: wait_for_idle polls the pane every --check seconds until the last line is a bare prompt again. Readiness uses idle (bare-prompt) semantics so an echoed command line like '>>> time.sleep(5)' is correctly reported busy, unlike the reference's search-based detect_kind. Optional --timeout bounds the wait.
close_reason: Completed and verified against a live tmux Python REPL.

title: Implement prompt matching and command/output extraction core
description: core.rs: Prompt struct with search and idle matching semantics, last-command/output extraction from pane history mirroring the Python reference (last prompt line + second-to-last prompt line, strip prompt prefix, join output). Whitespace-tolerant idle check so capture-pane -N padding and tmux trailing-space trimming don't defeat prompt regexes ending in a literal space.
close_reason: Completed and verified against a live tmux Python REPL.

title: Implement tmux pane capture and send-keys helpers
description: Thin wrappers around 'tmux capture-pane -t <pane> -p -S -<max_lines>' and 'tmux send-keys -t <pane> <command> Enter', mirroring the Python core.py helpers. Errors surfaced with the tmux stderr message.
close_reason: Completed and verified against a live tmux Python REPL.

title: Scaffold the muxxy Rust project with a clap-based CLI
description: Initialize the cargo project with clap derive for arg parsing. Global flags: --prompt (required regex), --pane, --max-lines, --pretty. Subcommands mirroring the tmux-repl-mcp MCP tools: is-repl-ready, get-last-command, execute-command.
close_reason: Completed and verified against a live tmux Python REPL.
